title: Mosaic Lamp Workshop in Brighton, MA
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please see the link below for Detailed Directions to our Brighton/Boston Workshop venue: https://support.mosaicartstudio.us/portal/en/kb/articles/brighton-address
Allergy Notice: Our Turkish delights contain nuts. Please inform us of any allergies before the workshop.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Unleash your creativity where you can craft your own stunning mosaic lamp. Guided by skilled instructors, explore the rich history of Turkish mosaic art as you design and assemble your masterpiece using colorful glass tiles and beads. This hands-on workshop accommodates all skill levels, making it perfect for families, friends, and team-building events. Enjoy the relaxing atmosphere with Turkish tea and treats as you admire your finished artwork, ready to light up your home.
